Real fonts for tests, each under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt` beside it), from
github.com/google/fonts (`ofl/<dir>/`), renamed only (`[wght]` → `-VF`), otherwise unmodified.

| File | Kind |
|---|---|
| `outfit/Outfit-VF.ttf` | variable sans, weight 100–900 |
| `barlow/Barlow-Light.ttf` | static sans, weight 300 |
| `redhatmono/RedHatMono-VF.ttf` | variable mono, weight 300–700 |
